main.description: The authoritative half of a membership: this org's repo asserts that `subject` is a member. The record key IS the member's DID, so a membership check is a single getRecord and listRecords yields the full member list.

subject.description: The member. MUST equal the record key; a mismatch makes the record invalid, not a membership.

role.description: Lowercase, digits and dashes only. Compared exactly by consumers — never ordered, never case-folded.

validUntil.description: End of the membership. Absent means open-ended.
